rationale: The paper estimates an accident probability under a base distribution of standard traffic behavior and identifies estimating that distribution as essential. This supports the conditional nature of the risk metric and the claim's rejection of unconditional safety inference from total miles. The stated simulator and threshold conditions remain necessary qualifications.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-003-R1 — PDF p. 1, abstract and introduction
S-EVID-003-R2 — PDF p. 2, base distribution and simulation inputs
limitations: This is a highway research case study, not a regulator-approved safety case.
The source does not validate simulator fidelity, tail assumptions, or transfer to aircraft encounters.
